overview:
**Very High fire danger today in the Montrose High Elevation area, driven by critically dry fuels (ERC at 92%, the top local threshold).**
- Danger eases to High for the rest of the week as ERC drops into the 70–82% range through August 18.
- Afternoon storms are possible today (50% chance) with gusty, shifting winds, but little cooling relief follows.
- 1 of 7 local watchout thresholds is currently tripped — the ERC benchmark.
- Stage 2 fire restrictions remain active across Montrose and Gunnison counties, limiting campfires, smoking, and open burning. Stage 2 Fire Restrictions will take effect across all of Montrose County, including all state lands, starting at 0001 a.m. on Friday, August 8. Gunnison County has been in Stage 2 Fire Restrictions since June 30, 2026.
- Nearby: the Gold Mountain Fire continues burning two miles north of Ouray with active uphill runs and closures in place, and the Elk Fire near Lake City is holding at roughly 7,226 acres, about 33% contained.
